Why skills matter

Knowledge becomes powerful when people can put it to work.

Sifa Skilling Hub (SSH) equips youth and women with practical skills, entrepreneurship opportunities and the knowledge needed to become self-reliant.

Skills development is central to AMEF’s commitment to economic empowerment and improved livelihoods. The aim is not training for its own sake, but capability that can be translated into confidence, enterprise and greater household resilience.

From potentialto practical possibility.
